A '''residence''' in the suburbs of [[Lazeria City]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]]<ref name="TSoK" /> of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Lazerian system/Legends|Lazerian system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Lazerian IV]], was the place in which the trusted [[Aide/Legends|aide]] to [[King/Legends|King]] [[Alarik X]] and [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the [[King's Own Guard]], [[Alroy Kever]], resided. [[Empeth Crystal]]s&mdash;a type of [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-enhancing crystal [[Mining/Legends|mined]] from Lazerian IV's [[Crystal Valley (Lazerian IV)|Crystal Valley]]&mdash;were delivered to and stored in Kever's residence after being mined. Kever would then [[Security guard/Legends|guard]] the crystals alongside four other members of the King's Own Guard, as well as several [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|3PO-series protocol droids]].<ref name="TSoK" />

==Behind the scenes==
Alroy Kever's residence was created by [[John Terra]] and introduced in [[Twin Stars of Kira (sourcebook)|''Twin Stars of Kira'']], a [[1993]] supplement to [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TSoK" />
